title: Gas Optimization and Performance
learning_outcomes: Explain the main ideas in Gas Optimization and Performance and correctly use the key terms in context.
Build or inspect a minimal Solidity example that demonstrates the lesson concepts.
Test representative failure cases and describe version, security, or operational assumptions where relevant.

overview_visual.alt_text: A two-column ordered roadmap for Module 16: Gas Optimization and Performance; it lists all 13 source-syllabus lesson topics by number.
overview_visual.caption: Module 16 roadmap: Understanding Gas Consumption; Measuring Gas Usage in Tests; Storage Reads and Writes; Packing Storage Variables; Choosing Between Arrays, Mappings, and Other Structures; Calldata and Memory Efficiency; Loop Cost and Unbounded Iteration; Arithmetic and Bitwise Optimization; Custom Errors and Revert-Data Costs; Optimizer and Compiler Configuration; Gas Snapshots and Regression Checks; Benchmarking Before and After Changes; Balancing Optimization, Readability, and Security. Work through the topics in order, then implement a small example and verify assumptions.
